verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for a cloud-backed POS and commerce SaaS, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents choosing a storage region or residency for merchant data. The shopify.storage extension API only persists data between sessions; it is not a residency control and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
